title: Website Designing
summary: Fast, modern, mobile-first websites that actually convert visitors into customers.
seoDescription: Custom, mobile-first website design built to convert visitors into customers.
imageAlt: Before and after comparison of an outdated business website versus a modern StarBlaze-designed website
body:
Your website is often the first impression a customer has of your business — StarBlaze designs websites that load fast, look professional on any device, and are built to turn visitors into enquiries or sales, not just look pretty.

**What's included:**

- Custom design tailored to your brand — not a generic template
- Mobile-first, fast-loading pages
- Clear calls-to-action built around your actual business goals
- Basic on-page SEO from day one

**Who it's for:** Businesses that don't have a website yet, or have one that's outdated, slow, or doesn't reflect the business anymore.

title: Fully Managed Website Hosting
summary: We keep your site online, secure, and fast — so you never have to think about servers.
seoTitle: Fully Managed Website Hosting | StarBlaze Ventures
seoDescription: Managed website hosting with backups, security monitoring, and direct support.
imageAlt: Server uptime dashboard showing green status indicators
body:
Website hosting shouldn't be something you have to learn. We handle server setup, security updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and renewals — if anything goes wrong, we're the ones who get the alert, not you.

**What's included:**

- Server setup and configuration
- Regular backups
- Security monitoring and updates
- Uptime monitoring
- Direct support when something needs fixing

**Who it's for:** Any business that wants their website to just work, without managing a hosting account, renewals, or technical issues themselves.

title: Managed Cloud Services
summary: Cloud infrastructure, set up and maintained for you, sized to what your business actually needs.
seoDescription: Right-sized cloud infrastructure setup, monitoring, and maintenance.
imageAlt: Cloud infrastructure diagram showing connected services
body:
Whether it's email, file storage, business applications, or backend infrastructure for your own product, we set up and manage cloud services sized to your business — not an enterprise package you'll never fully use, and not a bare-bones setup that breaks under real usage.

**What's included:**

- Cloud environment setup and configuration
- Ongoing monitoring and maintenance
- Scaling guidance as your business grows
- Cost optimization — right-sized, not over-provisioned

**Who it's for:** Businesses running internal tools, apps, or infrastructure that needs a managed cloud setup instead of ad-hoc, unmanaged servers.

title: GMB Services
summary: Get found on Google Maps and Search, with a Business Profile that's fully optimized and kept up to date.
seoTitle: Google Business Profile (GMB) Services | StarBlaze Ventures
seoDescription: Google Business Profile setup, optimization, and ongoing management.
imageAlt: Google Business Profile listing showing reviews, photos, and business hours
body:
Most local customers check Google before they check anything else. We set up and optimize your Google Business Profile — accurate hours, photos, categories, posts, and review management — so you show up, and show up well, when someone nearby searches for what you offer.

**What's included:**

- Google Business Profile setup or clean-up
- Ongoing posts and updates
- Review monitoring and response support
- Local SEO improvements tied to your GMB listing

**Who it's for:** Any business with a physical location or local service area that wants to show up in "near me" searches and Google Maps.

title: AI & Automation
summary: Automate the repetitive parts of your business with AI tools built around how you actually work.
seoDescription: Custom AI automation for customer queries, lead handling, and internal workflows.
imageAlt: Automated workflow diagram showing AI handling customer queries and routing leads
body:
From answering common customer questions to organizing leads to generating first drafts of content, we build AI-powered automations around your actual workflows — not generic chatbots, but tools shaped around how your business really operates.

**What's included:**

- Workflow audit to find what's worth automating
- Custom AI automation setup (chat, lead handling, content, internal tools)
- Integration with tools you already use
- Ongoing tuning as your needs change

**Who it's for:** Businesses spending too much time on repetitive tasks — answering the same questions, manually sorting leads, or copy-pasting information between tools.

title: WhatsApp Marketing & Automation
summary: Reach customers where they already are, with automated flows that feel personal.
seoDescription: WhatsApp Business API setup, automated flows, and broadcast campaign management.
imageAlt: WhatsApp Business chat showing an automated order confirmation flow
body:
WhatsApp is where your customers already are. We build automated flows for order updates, broadcast campaigns, catalog sharing, and customer support — set up properly so it feels responsive and personal, not like a mass-blast spam channel.

**What's included:**

- WhatsApp Business API setup
- Automated flows (order updates, FAQs, catalog sharing)
- Broadcast campaign setup and management
- Integration with your existing sales/support process

**Who it's for:** Businesses that want to sell, support, and follow up with customers directly over WhatsApp without doing it all manually.

title: Performance Marketing
summary: Paid campaigns built around measurable return, not vanity metrics.
seoDescription: Paid campaign strategy, setup, and optimization across Google, Meta, and more.
imageAlt: Marketing analytics dashboard showing ad spend and conversion metrics
body:
We run paid campaigns across the platforms that matter for your business — built, tracked, and optimized around actual return on ad spend, not follower counts or impressions that don't turn into revenue.

**What's included:**

- Campaign strategy and setup (Google, Meta, and other relevant platforms)
- Conversion tracking so you know what's actually working
- Ongoing optimization based on real performance data
- Regular, plain-language reporting

**Who it's for:** Businesses ready to spend on advertising but want it managed properly, with clear accountability for the results.

title: Social Media Management
summary: Consistent, on-brand presence across your social channels, without you lifting a finger.
seoDescription: Content planning, creation, scheduling, and community management for social media.
imageAlt: Social media content calendar showing scheduled posts across platforms
body:
Posting consistently, staying on-brand, and actually engaging with followers takes real time — time most business owners don't have. We plan, create, and post content across your social channels so your presence stays active and consistent.

**What's included:**

- Content calendar and planning
- Post creation and scheduling
- Basic community management (comments, DMs where relevant)
- Monthly performance review

**Who it's for:** Businesses that know they need to be active on social media but don't have the time or team to do it consistently.

title: Custom Business Software, Apps & Solutions
summary: When off-the-shelf tools stop being enough, we build exactly what your business needs.
seoTitle: Custom Business Software & App Development | StarBlaze Ventures
seoDescription: Custom software, apps, and solutions built around your specific business workflows.
imageAlt: Custom business software dashboard showing a client-specific workflow tool
body:
Sometimes generic tools stop fitting — a specific workflow, an internal tool, a customer-facing app that doesn't exist yet. We design and build custom software and applications built specifically around how your business actually operates.

**What's included:**

- Requirements discovery and scoping
- Custom app/software design and development
- Integration with your existing tools and data
- Ongoing support and iteration post-launch

**Who it's for:** Businesses that have outgrown off-the-shelf tools, or have a specific operational problem no existing product solves well.
